depiction.primary_object: camera outline containing a centered microphone in place of lens
modifiers: microphone glyph embedded inside camera body
depiction.composition: single composite object, front view, thick black line art

readings.meaning: voice note attached to photo / narrated slideshow

ambiguity: At small sizes, the microphone cradle inside the camera could be mistaken for a stylized camera lens, a power symbol, or a USB-C port indicator.

modifier_semantics.meaning: audio input, voice capture, or external microphone for a camera

reasoning: The icon combines a camera body outline with a centered microphone in place of the lens. It works well for tasks specifically involving camera audio gear (shotgun mics, wireless lavs, vlogging setups), audio-annotated photos, or combined camera-and-mic permissions, though for general photography or plain voice recording a simpler camera or microphone icon is better.
